label: Узнать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for узнать (to find out, recognize).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person. 'Узнаю' is the я-form of perfective узнать and carries future meaning. The imperfective partner узнавать has the present-tense узнаю with shifting stress.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person. 'Узнаешь' takes the -аешь ending. As a perfective, it points to a single moment of finding out the whole truth.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person singular. 'Узнает' is the он-form ending in -ает. Here узнать means to recognize someone, a completed act of identification.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Узнаем' shows the мы-form ending -аем. 'Позже' signals a finished act of learning the rules later on.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Узнают' is the они-form with the -ают ending. Being perfective, it marks a single discovery of the secret.
Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Узнал' is the masculine singular past of perfective узнать. 'Случайно' frames the discovery as an unexpected, completed event.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Узнала' adds the feminine -а ending. Here узнать means to recognize, and 'сразу' stresses instant identification.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Узнали' is the plural past form ending in -и. It reports that the neighbours found out the news as a finished fact.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Узнай' is the informal command of perfective узнать. It tells one person to find out a specific piece of information.

missions.phrase: Я хочу узнать твоё настоящее имя.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Modal infinitive use. 'Хочу' governs the bare infinitive 'узнать', the perfective form. The sentence expresses a wish to find out one specific fact.
